messages.subject: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €32.20 per unit for a volume of 19890 pcs per year. Our Lieferzeit is 54 days, and the contract term is 12 months. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. All deliveries and services are strictly subject to our standard procedure and standard conditions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

messages.subject: part:340010 – firm 24/36-month commitment for full volume
messages.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your quote. We understand you prioritise firm, long-term commitments, so we offer one: 23,400 pcs per year over 24 or 36 months.

Our forecast fc:340010@2026-09 records a +10.1% volume change, so this commitment is solid demand. Our should-cost cost:340010 estimates your unit cost at EUR 24.31, well below the quoted EUR 32.20. Scorecard sc:70410@2026Q3 shows 79.5% on-time delivery, so a binding 42-day lead time matters to us.

As changes above 2% need your pricing committee, please submit the attached packages for its next review. What is your earliest feasible lead time, and is there a cheaper variant?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: part:340010 – firm 24/36-month commitment for full volume
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Your should-cost estimates do not reflect the realities of our specialised manufacturing processes. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.

We accept the 36-month commitment for 23,400 units, which allows us to revise our price to EUR 31.80. A 42-day lead time is not feasible given our current utilisation; 54 days remains our earliest possible lead time. Our Lieferzeit is 42 days.

Our offer is a price of €33.70 per unit, Lieferzeit 42 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months. This offer stays valid for 7 days.

Alternatively, with Lieferzeit 54 days: €31.80 per unit. As an alternative, we offer a price of €31.80 per unit, Lieferzeit 54 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
